description: This file defines the EmployeeSkillDecorator class, which provides methods to decorate the EmployeeSkill entity with additional behaviors such as setting associated Employee and Skill objects via their IDs.

classes.name: EmployeeSkillDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmployeeSkill entity, providing methods to associate Employee and Skill entities via their IDs.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with an EmployeeSkill instance.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity for the EmployeeSkill based on the employee number.

methods.name: setSkillBySkillId
methods.description: Sets the Skill entity for the EmployeeSkill based on the skill ID.
